description: PWM on pin 11: 0, then 25 (the same example on the Mega 2560).
basis: the output of the example on the Uno (class derived: derived by hand from the sketch source (C++ semantics, avr-gcc: int is 16 bit) and the 'Beobachtung' comment of the example; wiring_analog.c: analogWrite(0) is digitalWrite(LOW), 25 sets OCR2A = 25 on the Uno) holds for the Mega 2560: pin 11 is TIMER1A there (digital_pin_to_timer_PGM of the mega variant), which wiring.c also runs in an 8-bit PWM mode, so OCR1A = 25 and the duty cycle equals the value; nothing else differs (no pin above 13, same core 1.8.8); no recording on a Mega exists
